privacy.identifiers: Use aggregate metrics, opaque correlation IDs and redacted technical identifiers only.

alerts.condition: Fewer than 50% of probes return the expected successful response
alerts.action: Declare SEV1, validate origin and CDN health, then follow the outage and rollback decision path.

alerts.signal: DNS resolution, TLS handshake and certificate validity
alerts.condition: Canonical hostname does not resolve, TLS fails, or certificate is invalid for the hostname
alerts.action: Declare SEV1, preserve DNS and certificate evidence, and follow the DNS/TLS runbook.

alerts.signal: Security headers, release SHA, release manifest, service worker and deployed assets
alerts.condition: Deployed SHA or assets differ from the approved manifest, required headers are absent, or the service worker cannot load
alerts.action: Stop promotion, compare immutable artifacts, and evaluate frontend rollback.

alerts.signal: Database health, API failures and integrity checks
alerts.condition: Database operations broadly fail or evidence indicates probable corruption or data loss
alerts.action: Freeze writes when safely possible, preserve evidence, escalate to the provider and follow the database incident runbook.

alerts.signal: Postgres errors, connection pressure, latency, RPC failures and unexpected RLS denials
alerts.condition: Error or latency rate remains above its calibrated baseline for the full window
alerts.action: Correlate API and Postgres logs, identify affected operations, and mitigate without weakening RLS.

alerts.signal: Database size, storage usage, connection utilization and table growth
alerts.condition: Projected capacity crosses 80% of an approved limit within 30 days
alerts.action: Validate the trend, identify growth sources and schedule capacity or retention review.

alerts.signal: Synthetic login and authenticated profile lookup
alerts.condition: All synthetic login attempts fail while the frontend remains reachable
alerts.action: Declare SEV1, suspend risky account operations and follow the Auth outage runbook.

alerts.signal: Failed logins, session events, privileged activity, recovery limits and inactive-account attempts
alerts.condition: Activity exceeds the calibrated baseline or an inactive account repeatedly attempts protected operations
alerts.action: Review redacted audit evidence, scope the identities affected and escalate severity if compromise is suspected.

alerts.signal: Requests, 5xx, timeouts, latency and runtime configuration errors
alerts.condition: 5xx or timeout ratio exceeds 10% for a required function or fail-closed configuration errors persist
alerts.action: Identify the function version and configuration fingerprint, contain impact and evaluate rollback.

alerts.signal: Expected function allowlist and versions versus deployed inventory
alerts.condition: A required function is missing, an unexpected function is active, or the deployed version differs from the approved release
alerts.action: Stop promotion, preserve inventory evidence and reconcile only through the approved release process.

alerts.signal: Recovery requests, registered codes, delivery status, confirmation and provider health
alerts.condition: More than 20% of valid synthetic recovery deliveries fail or provider health is degraded
alerts.action: Preserve neutral public responses, inspect provider and Edge evidence, and follow the recovery runbook.

alerts.signal: Expired codes, reuse attempts, invalid attempts and rate-limit events
alerts.condition: Any signal materially exceeds its calibrated baseline without a matching product event
alerts.action: Review aggregated evidence, preserve response neutrality and escalate if targeted abuse is probable.

alerts.signal: Targets found, dispatch completion, provider acceptance, sent and failed deliveries
alerts.condition: More than 25% of attempted deliveries fail across multiple valid devices
alerts.action: Compare internal recipients with ledger rows, provider responses and affected device classes.

alerts.signal: 404/410, device deactivation, stuck claims, batch limits and internal-recipient/delivery mismatch
alerts.condition: Claims remain sending beyond 10 minutes, a batch limit is reached, or ledger counts diverge from expected targets
alerts.action: Inspect redacted ledger data, distinguish invalid endpoints from provider failure and avoid manual duplicate dispatch.

alerts.signal: Upload and download errors, signed URL failures and access denials
alerts.condition: More than 10% of valid synthetic Storage operations fail across more than one bucket
alerts.action: Correlate Storage and API logs, verify policies without weakening access control, and follow the database incident runbook.

alerts.signal: Per-bucket growth, object size, MIME rejection and denied access
alerts.condition: Growth approaches 80% of an approved quota or rejection/denial rates exceed baseline
alerts.action: Validate bucket, MIME and access patterns using aggregated evidence; schedule capacity or policy review.

alerts.signal: Secret scanning, unauthorized use, leaked credential report or anomalous privileged access
alerts.condition: Any credible evidence of a private credential, VAPID private key or privileged token exposure
alerts.action: Declare SEV1, contain access, rotate in dependency order and preserve evidence without copying the secret.
